ai_result.long_description:
Keep everyday essentials organized with this handmade horizontal leather belt pouch. Its low-profile design is made for discreet belt carry while providing space for up to 10 cards, cash, coins, or other small essentials.

Each pouch is made by hand using traditional saddle stitching. The leather is left uncolored to preserve its natural character and finished with a special protective wax coating for moisture resistance. Measuring 2.75 inches high × 4.33 inches wide × 0.79 inches deep (70 mm × 110 mm × 20 mm), it fits standard belts up to 1.57 inches wide (up to 40 mm).

A practical EDC accessory and a thoughtful gift for him, this compact belt pouch keeps frequently used items close without adding unnecessary bulk.
